SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: Anonymous training satisfaction evaluation submitted once per device without login or respondent PII.

deviceId.description: Anonymous client-generated device identifier stored in localStorage to prevent duplicate submissions.

surveyKey.description: Identifier of the training session survey.

q1.description: Rating 1-5 for knowledge and understanding gained.

q3.description: Rating 1-5 for training materials and media.

q4.description: Rating 1-5 for instructor clarity and delivery.

comment.description: Optional anonymous suggestion or feedback (max 500 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded at submission time.

/responses/{deviceId}.description: Stores anonymous training evaluation responses keyed by deviceId to enforce one submission per device.
